task_label: Implement semantic multi-step routine reuse core with calendar+routing pilot
problem_statement: The approved Spec 31 requires the existing saved-routine path to reuse a matching multi-step routine from natural language when a safe semantic structure match and fresh parameter binding are available. This first slice must generalize the narrow weather-only semantic reuse path into a reusable core, add the first safe calendar.list_events + system.routing pilot, preserve the existing weather path, and ensure current request values override historical routine-run values.

latest_user_evidence.actual: Spec 31 is approved and prechecked, but the current execution path still needs the bounded semantic multi-step reuse core and first routing pilot implemented.
latest_user_evidence.expected: A natural request from the calendar+routing pilot family reuses a matching saved routine with current request values, the weather reuse path still works, and Janus shows only the short passive routine-used hint.

acceptance_criteria: Only allowlisted backend routine/orchestrator files and focused tests may change.
A natural request from the pilot family calendar.list_events + system.routing can reuse a matching saved routine through the general semantic multi-step reuse core.
Current request values for date, start, or destination override historical routine-run values.
The existing natural reuse path for calendar.list_events + system.weather remains intact.
Successful reuse still shows only the short passive routine-used hint.
Do not add UI, routine management, embeddings, vector search, provider fallback, transport changes, OAuth, Git, release, or broader architecture changes.
cursor_prompt_contract: Use Cursor for one bounded execution patch. Inspect only allowlisted files, implement the smallest safe semantic multi-step routine reuse core plus the calendar+routing pilot with fresh parameter precedence, preserve the weather regression path, run the listed checks, and return concise JSON-compatible output.
